about_the_game:
Forge a Civilization from Nothing

From the ashes of a fallen world rises an unlikely sanctuary: a lush, yet perilous island named Luthenia. As the leader of a handful of survivors, your task is to guide them from the brink of extinction and lay the foundations of a new society, a new civilization.

Luthenia is a deep colony simulation where every individual matters. You don't give direct orders; instead, you shape your community's ideological core through laws and make critical decisions when faced with unexpected events.

From Survival to Civilization

Everything begins at the most primitive level. Witness the desperate first days as your Settlers gather their own food, craft their first crude tools by tying stones to sticks, and build their own makeshift shelters to survive the night. Watch as this individual struggle evolves into the first workshops and a fledgling barter economy.

As your society grows and barter becomes inefficient, guide the birth of a currency and oversee the transformation of your island into a living, breathing economy driven by supply and demand. Every Settler is an individual with their own needs, hopes, and families to build. Their story will be written by your political vision.

Features:

  • Deep Individual Simulation: Every Settler is a living person with unique needs, skills, and social relationships.

  • Organic Progression: Evolve from a primitive struggle for survival to a complex, dynamic economy with production chains and a market based on supply and demand.

  • Ideological Governance: Govern your society through laws and policies. Collectivism or individualism? Tradition or progress? Every decision has consequences that deeply impact the cultural and political fabric of your civilization.

  • Challenging Decisions: Make tough moral and political choices when faced with famine, disease, and internal conflicts that will define your society's values and future.

  • Emergent Narratives: Every playthrough tells a unique story, shaped by the personal dramas of your Settlers and the consequences of your leadership.

What kind of civilization will you build in this new world? Welcome to Luthenia.
